title: Create the Vapor Wares public arm for Homebrew divisions
description: Create a real pub arm for Vapor Wares and mount the public Homebrew app/tap repositories there instead of carrying public remotes inside the private p arm.
acceptanceCriteria: homebrew-apps and homebrew-tap are mounted under gtwy/pub/vapor-wares.
The private p arm no longer declares public Homebrew remotes.
